windows.name: Know The Mice for Windows
windows.description: Modern Liquid Glass installer with pure black aesthetic, auto-start, system tray host, firewall rules, and desktop shortcuts.
windows.changelog:
- High-contrast AMOLED squircle system tray icon with orange border
- Background process stability & minimize-to-tray
- Unified 9-token gradient system across all surfaces
- Single-file setup installer with auto-start

android.name: Know The Mice for Android
requirements: Connected to the same local Wi-Fi as your PC
android.description: Native Android System IME integration (Gboard, Samsung Keyboard), Voice Typing dictation, Touchpad with multi-touch gestures, Gyroscope Air Mouse, universal media deck, and presentation controls.
android.changelog:
- Native Android System Keyboard IME (Gboard, Samsung Keyboard, SwiftKey)
- Voice dictation typing support directly to PC
- Configurable input modes (Text, Multiline, Number, URL, Email, Password)
- Compact PC modifier toolbar (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win, Esc, Tab, arrows, shortcuts)
- Adaptive icon safe-zone alignment (60% scale within 108dp canvas)
